notes.title: Further update: Issues with Monitors using G-SYNC
notes.notes:
This a follow-up to the early announcement we posted on 14th February 2018, which was entitled as “Issues with Monitors using G-SYNC”.

We requested NVIDIA to investigate the issue and they have come back with the following report.

“This is an issue that can occur in games on fixed-FPS such as FINAL FANTASY XII THE ZODIAC AGE, due to the current design specifications of G-SYNC.
Please disable G-SYNC by following the steps as specified below.” 


Step1:  NVIDIA control panel-> Manage 3D Settings -> Open “Program Settings” tab

Step2:  Select FINAL FANTASY XII THE ZODIAC AGE from “Select the program to customize”

Step3:  Set the monitor technology to the specified fixed refresh rate in “Specify the settings for this program”
